statements: DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS core.sp;

CREATE TABLE core.customer (id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, code VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0, doubled DECIMAL(10,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (amount * 2) STORED, state INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uq_code (code), CHECK (amount >= 0), KEY idx_state (state)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='customers';
CREATE TABLE core.orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2), CONSTRAINT fk_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES core.customer(id));
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_amount ON core.orders (amount);
ALTER TABLE core.orders ADD COLUMN note VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL;
CREATE VIEW core.active_customers AS SELECT id, code FROM core.customer WHERE state = 1;
SELECT @total := COUNT(*) FROM core.customer WHERE code LIKE 'a;%';
SET @total = COALESCE(@total, 0);
SHOW CREATE TABLE core.customer;
GRANT SELECT ON core.customer TO 'reader'@'localhost';
CREATE FUNCTION core.f_simple() RETURNS INT DETERMINISTIC RETURN 1
CREATE TRIGGER core.tr_orders BEFORE INSERT ON core.orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.amount = COALESCE(NEW.amount, 0)
CREATE EVENT core.ev_daily ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 DAY DO BEGIN UPDATE core.customer SET state = 1 WHERE id = 1; END
CALL core.sp(1, 'a');
SELECT id, amount FROM core.orders WHERE amount > 0 ORDER BY id;
SELECT id, state INTO @picked, @status FROM core.customer WHERE id = 1;
LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE '/tmp/customer.csv' INTO TABLE core.customer FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' LINES TERMINATED BY '\n' (code, amount);
CREATE USER 'reader'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'pw';
REVOKE SELECT ON core.customer FROM 'reader'@'localhost';
ALTER TABLE core.orders MODIFY COLUMN note VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL;
PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
EXECUTE stmt;
DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
